source_warning: The PDF states the 5,000 respondents are synthetic demonstration data, not actual Steel Corporation Pvt. Ltd. customers or real survey participants.
context: Employment/job-search difficulty, industry readiness, AI awareness/adoption, digital product interest and monthly willingness to pay.
page_4_insights: Unemployed respondents: job-search difficulty 3.91/5 (n=575), versus 3.20 overall.
Respondent concentration: Other Tier 2/3 20.3%, Delhi NCR 12.0%, Bengaluru 10.6%; concentration is not market size.
Perceived AI skill gap: 55.4% believe employers want AI skills, 13.2% report having them; gap 42.3 percentage points.
Age 18–21 leads AI adoption index at 60/100 (n=862).
Employed respondents report highest mean willingness to pay INR 464/month; stated intent, not observed spending.
usage_rule: Keep separate from UCI steel fault data; do not present as company customers or plant metrics.
